text:
You need small WordPress edits on your existing travel site plus a simple solar landing page/blog with Facebook integration and room for future maintenance.  

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.  

Relevant work: I built a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics in 4 languages with instant search, and support tickets dropped 27%. I also rebuilt a home goods storefront for Juniper & Ash Home, improving largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s.  

I’m comfortable working in WordPress, editing existing content, and handling the small structural tweaks you described. I can join phone, Teams, or Zoom meetings and stay available for ongoing updates if needed.
